recordings.remarks: Bioacoustic survey conducted with a Song Meter Micro full-spectrum acoustic recorder deployed in a degraded remnant of Valley Grassy Forest (EVC 47) located within the Yackandandah Creek Frontage reserve. Nearby is a large pond formed by historic mining activity. Recordings were scheduled twice a day. First, for 3 hours commencing two hours before sunrise, and secondly, for 3 hours commencing at sunset.
recordings.carol_category: harsh 'chop' calls (yellow-tufted, Yackandandah VIC, song meter; steady ~6.4 kHz insect tone)
recordings.attribution: iNaturalist sound 1799241 (observation 342159724) by Mononymous, inaturalist.org/observations/342159724, Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0
